title: Frustration that grows over the conversation
description: The customer starts neutral and gets more and more upset about a late order.
expected_behavior: Valence falls and activity rises message by message. The state over time must show it. The system should offer a human or escalate before the end.

messages.text: Hi, my order 4821 has not arrived yet.
It was supposed to be here three days ago.
Nobody has answered my two emails. This is really frustrating.
This is unacceptable! I want my money back!!
I am furious. I will contact a lawyer if this is not solved today.
